model_settings.value: Random forest classification implemented in R using the randomForest library; 2,000 classification trees, bootstrapped participant samples, and randomly selected predictor subsets with the number of variables per tree set to the square root of the total number of variables. Permutation importance scores were used for variable selection; median importance scores from 500 repetitions were used to select up to 10 predictors for the final reduced model, evaluated using out-of-bag samples.
